panel.title: Rasters
panel.description: Each button renders a local raster through a different path.

section.title: Local rasters
section.description: Drawing {source}. A continuous ramp stretched across sparse class codes renders them near-black; class_colors draws each one exactly. Set {env_var} to use real products.

errors.title: A failed task
errors.description: This button points at a raster that is not there, so its task fails. The error toast stays until you close it or start another task, and the log keeps the failure.
